================================================================================
preproc directive terminated by blanks + newline
================================================================================

#ifdef X
#define A 
#endif
int x;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (preproc_ifdef
    (identifier)
    (preproc_def
      (identifier)))
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (identifier)))

================================================================================
indented preproc directive with trailing blanks
================================================================================

#ifdef X
#  define B 
#endif
int y;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (preproc_ifdef
    (identifier)
    (preproc_def
      (identifier)))
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (identifier)))

================================================================================
define with value still parses
================================================================================

#ifdef X
#define A B
#endif
int z;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (preproc_ifdef
    (identifier)
    (preproc_def
      (identifier)
      (preproc_arg)))
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (identifier)))

================================================================================
line continuation with trailing blanks
================================================================================

#define C 1 \
2
int c;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (preproc_def
    (identifier)
    (preproc_arg))
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (identifier)))
